chunks: So you place your trust in God. Certainly you stand on positive truth.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to place trust in God while standing on clear truth?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah An-Naml, this verse serves as a divine reassurance to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) amidst the trials of conveying the message, emphasizing that true reliance on Allah (Tawakkul) is rooted in the certainty of standing upon clear truth (Al-Haqq al-Mubin). Shia exegetes often highlight this as a model for the Imams, who, like the Prophet, embody this perfect trust and clarity in guiding the Ummah. It underscores the spiritual principle that divine support accompanies those who remain steadfast in their mission despite opposition.
